problem_statement: Build a brand-new Roadmap page from scratch at the /roadmap route of this Convertly SaaS marketing site. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the 404 page. Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system (the fixed Header with the Convertly wordmark and nav, the shared Footer, the blue-to-cyan gradient accent, the rounded white card style, Inter font and the max-w-7xl section container). The page is a static product roadmap: a badge, a large gradient page heading, an intro paragraph, and a responsive grid of quarterly milestone cards — each card shows its quarter label, a milestone title, a delivery status, a short description and a bullet list of the features planned for that quarter. It closes with a feature-request call to action. There is no interaction. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A large page heading that reads 'Product Roadmap' with the site's blue-to-cyan gradient accent on 'Roadmap'
An introductory paragraph explaining the roadmap shows what has shipped and what is coming next
A responsive grid of quarterly milestone cards mounted inside the existing Header + Footer site shell
A 'Foundation' milestone card for the first quarter (labelled 'Q1 2026'), marked as shipped, describing the core platform
A 'Collaboration' milestone card (labelled 'Q2 2026') marked in progress, describing real-time teamwork features
An 'Intelligence' milestone card ('Q3 2026') and a 'Scale' milestone card ('Q4 2026'), both marked planned, for the later quarters

Each milestone card shows its quarter label (Q1 2026 through Q4 2026), a real <h3> milestone title, a delivery status line written as 'Status: Shipped' / 'Status: In Progress' / 'Status: Planned', and a bullet list of that quarter's planned features
A closing feature-request call to action inviting users to suggest features
design_constraints: Reuse the existing site chrome: mount the page inside the shared Header (Convertly wordmark + nav) and Footer used on the home page
Keep the blue-to-cyan gradient accent, rounded white card style (rounded-2xl, shadow-lg, border-slate-100), Inter font and blue-700/cyan-500 palette; do not introduce a new visual language
Use the same max-w-7xl mx-auto section container and py-24 spacing as the other sections
The roadmap covers the four quarters of 2026: use the quarter labels 'Q1 2026', 'Q2 2026', 'Q3 2026' and 'Q4 2026' on the cards, in that order
Render each milestone title as a real <h3> heading element inside its card
Write each card's delivery status as a paragraph in the exact form 'Status: Shipped', 'Status: In Progress' or 'Status: Planned'

Palette tokens to reuse (Tailwind): blue-700 (#1d4ed8) and cyan-500 (#06b6d4) for the blue-to-cyan gradient accent, zinc-900 (#18181b) heading text on a near-white slate background (bg #f6faff / white #ffffff cards)
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /roadmap 是空 route (element={<></>}), 显式空元素阻断 catch-all 重定向到 NotFound; reference 完整实现静态 roadmap 页(badge + gradient 标题 + intro + 季度里程碑卡片网格 + CTA, 复用 Header/Footer/渐变色/卡片风格); bad 删掉整个里程碑卡片网格(只留 badge+标题+intro+CTA), 使 milestone 的 h3/p dom_assertions 失败。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。BrowserRouter 无 basename，vite 无 base，故 state_plan path 为 /roadmap。T1: 单静态页, 纯 dom_assertions, 无交互。
